goo.known_items.title: Known Items
item.goo.goo_label.tooltip: Holds a canister or vat to %s goo
item.goo.smithing_template.exorite_upgra: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
goo.ability.yore.rewind.description: Takes a mob back one step a cast: an adult into its baby, and a baby, or a mob with no baby, into its spawn egg.
goo.ability.yore.expire.description: Kills the struck mob outright, bosses excepted.
goo.ability.yore.ancient.description: No damage can take you below half a heart.
goo.ability.yore.age.description: Starts aging the block it strikes, which slowly becomes something older, such as coal into diamond.
death.attack.goo.holy: %1$s was burned away by holy light
death.attack.goo.molten_iron: %1$s wanted a cast of molten metal
death.attack.goo.molten_iron.player: %1$s wanted a cast of molten metal
goo.ability.blaze.kindle.description: Ember hearts shield your ash hearts, which reignite by how many embers remain.
goo.ability.blaze.molten.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of molten goo laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.blaze.molten.description: Held stream sprays molten goo that pools on floors and on lava.
goo.ability.blaze.flames.description: Hold to channel a stream of fire that cooks what it touches.
goo.ability.crystal.shatter.cost_mechani: Costs %s per block of shatter goo laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.crystal.shatter.description: Held stream sprays crystal goo that grows glass shards over it.
goo.ability.crystal.knives.description: Hold to form glass knives in a fan before you, then left click to throw them.
goo.ability.crystal.glimmer.description: Hold to detect nearby gemstone ores.
goo.ability.crystal.scales.description: Crystal shells on your hearts block damage before it reaches your life.
goo.ability.crystal.prism.description: Grows a prism where it lands, which reacts with other goo types.
goo.ability.astral.meteo.description: Calls a meteor down; it crashes through whatever stands above.
goo.ability.astral.lunar.description: Look at the moon and it takes you to it; on the moon, look at the blue star to go home.
goo.ability.astral.lunar.cost_mechanics: 1000 astral, paid when the moon or the star takes you.
goo.ability.astral.sun.refused: The big yellow one is the sun!
goo.ability.astral.scry.description: Hold to see the spaces around you.
goo.ability.deep.shriek.description: A blob that shrieks like a sculk shrieker and calls every hostile mob in earshot to it while it lasts; other mobs pay it no mind.
goo.ability.deep.host.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Host laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.deep.host.description: Held stream sprays Host, a sculky slime that sculk spreads eagerly through.
goo.ability.deep.click.description: Throw your voice: a click travels to wherever you look and sounds there, tripping sculk sensors and drawing a warden to the spot without pointing it back at you.
goo.ability.deep.sculker.description: Sense the world the way the deep does and swim through solid ground: sneak and jump together to dive in, swim with your movement keys, jump to rise and sneak to sink, and jump clear of a top face to stand on solid ground again. Stone never suffocates you while it lasts.
goo.ability.ender.seal.description: Curses a mob with teleportitis so it cannot reach you.
goo.ability.ender.blink.description: Teleports you a short way; blinking to a prism makes an Oculus.
goo.ability.ender.blink.cost_mechanics: Plus %s per block travelled and %s more through a wall; Oculus Blinks cost %s percent.
goo.ability.ender.end.description: Channel to summon a gate that takes you to the End.
goo.ability.ender.elude.description: When a mob or projectile would hurt you, you blink to a random safe spot within 8 blocks, facing a random way.
goo.ability.quantum.phase.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Phase laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.quantum.phase.description: Held stream sprays Phase, a flickering goo that puts whatever stands in it out of phase until it steps off.
goo.ability.quantum.tunnel.description: Opens a wormhole from the struck wall to the opening beyond, up to 32 blocks, for thirty seconds.
goo.ability.quantum.portal.description: Left click opens your blue portal and right click your orange one, where you look; a new one moves that color's portal, and your two portals link.
goo.ability.frost.nova.description: Hold to charge a frost nova that freezes and damages nearby mobs.
goo.ability.frost.cold.description: Hold to blow cold wind that freezes mobs.
goo.ability.frost.orb.description: A slow orb freezes mobs, water and lava in its path, ending in a frost nova.
goo.ability.frost.rime.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Rime laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.frost.rime.description: Held stream sprays Rime, a slippery endothermic goo that freezes the water and lava around it for good, a layer of it for each block frozen, and freezes whatever walks on it barefoot.
goo.ability.glow.bulb.description: Places a flat glowing crystal where its ray strikes; prisms become skyward beams.
goo.ability.glow.laser.description: Hold a damaging light beam; prisms become reflectors that split it and light the gaps between them.
goo.ability.glow.lux.description: Grants night vision, and mobs you look at glow.
goo.ability.glow.wisps.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Wisps laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.glow.wisps.description: Held stream sprays Wisps, a golden goo that shines brighter the deeper it lies.
goo.ability.hex.charm.description: Charms a mob to follow you and fight whatever targets you, until you hurt it.
goo.ability.hex.enchant.description: Enchants one book you carry at random, possibly with a curse.
goo.ability.hex.fuse.description: Fuses two identical enchanted books you carry into one a level higher.
goo.ability.hex.leech.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Leech laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.hex.leech.description: Held stream sprays Leech, a soul-steeped goo that slows whatever it catches while its spirits gnaw at it.
goo.ability.hex.drain.description: Hold to drain health from the creatures in a wide cone ahead.
goo.ability.jelly.heal.description: Channel a stream that heals you and every living thing in its cone.
goo.ability.jelly.gluttony.description: Healing past full becomes extra hearts, and eating past full banks hunger that refills as it drops.
goo.ability.jelly.reserve.description: Channel to bank health and hunger, at a loss, into reserves spent before your own.
goo.ability.jelly.nectar.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Nectar laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.jelly.nectar.description: Held stream sprays Nectar, a sweet jelly goo every mob craves: animals eat it a layer at a time to breed or grow, and hostiles fight over it. Aimed near a mob, the spray is thrown onto it.
goo.ability.leaf.barkskin.description: Regrowing bark hearts shield yours and thorn melee attackers, but fire and axes hit them hard.
goo.ability.leaf.vines.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Vines laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.leaf.vines.description: Held stream sprays Vines, a leafy goo that entangles whatever tries to cross it.
goo.ability.leaf.bloom.description: Spawns plants by chance around where the blob strikes.
goo.ability.leaf.growth.description: Channel a breeze that grows plants in its cone, speeds Barkskin's regrowth and infuses prisms.
goo.ability.leaf.reap.description: Swings a flurry of leaf blades in front of you while held, harvesting the ripe crops they cut and replanting any that drop a seed.
goo.ability.leaf.bio.description: A toxin drains a share of a mob's max health over time, stacking twice and refreshing on hit.
goo.ability.metal.dart.description: The blob becomes a dart in flight, stabbing a mob for moderate damage.
goo.ability.metal.magnet.description: Hold to sense nearby metal ores.
goo.ability.metal.spikes.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Spikes laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.metal.spikes.description: Held stream sprays Spikes, a thick coat of metal goo that forms spikes to impale whatever walks on it.
goo.ability.zombie.decay.description: Hold to spray rotting motes that gnaw away whatever they touch.
goo.ability.zombie.infest.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Infest laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.zombie.infest.description: Held stream sprays Infest, a festering zombie goo that gnaws away the blocks it lies on and bites whatever stands in it, healing the undead; each gnaw and bite may wear away a layer.
goo.ability.nether.tartarus.description: Channel to summon a gate that takes you to the nether, onto the nearest safe ground.
goo.ability.nether.tartarus.no_safe_floo: Tartarus finds no safe ground there.
goo.ability.zombie.undead.description: Fast-regenerating undead hearts fill your missing ones, but you count as undead and burn in sunlight.
goo.ability.pulse.signal.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Signal laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.pulse.signal.description: Held stream sprays Signal, a humming goo that sends a redstone signal as strong as its layers, one to fifteen.
goo.ability.pulse.tick.description: Channel to rapidly toggle levers, buttons, doors and gates in your aim; prisms become metronomes.
goo.ability.pulse.zap.description: Ticks the redstone it hits, pulses through walls, and turns prisms into wireless relays.
goo.ability.rock.bore.description: Channel a narrow stream that tunnels through mundane blocks and hurts the mobs inside.
goo.ability.rock.level.description: Hold on a block face to clear the blocks around until they lie level with it.
goo.ability.rock.petrify.description: Channel a fog that slowly turns mobs to stone and hardens exposed blocks.
goo.ability.rock.build.description: Drag a rectangle to raise stone from the ground as walls or other blocks.
goo.ability.rock.gouge.description: Hold to tear a chunk of earth from the ground, then left click to hurl it.
goo.ability.rock.mortar.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Mortar laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.rock.mortar.description: Held stream sprays Mortar, a stony goo that clings to walls and holds its shape.
goo.ability.rock.stoneskin.description: Stone hearts fill your missing ones and resist blows, but explosions and pickaxes crack them and regeneration stops.
goo.ability.shroom.mycosis.description: Spray spores that poison, slow and weaken mobs, which burst into spores on death.
goo.ability.shroom.spores.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Spores laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.shroom.spores.description: Held stream sprays Spores, a fungal goo that puffs spores and buds the ground at its edges, spending a little goo on each bud.
goo.ability.shroom.transmit.description: Near a fungus, move to the fungus block you aim at.
goo.ability.shroom.sight.description: Transmit reaches three times farther, and you see fungus blocks through walls.
goo.ability.kinetic.grab.description: Lifts the mob or item you look at; look down to pull it closer, left click to throw.
goo.ability.kinetic.slick.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of slick laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.kinetic.slick.description: Held stream lays a slippery film on floors that speeds up whatever slides on it.
goo.ability.kinetic.remote.description: You reach blocks and entities from farther away.
goo.ability.typhoon.shulk.description: Spews a shulker bullet at a mob, levitating it on the hit.
goo.ability.typhoon.float.description: You fly along your look and strafe keys, fall slowly without damage, and jump higher.
goo.ability.typhoon.pneuma.description: While held, refills your air and banks the overflow as a reserve for when you cannot breathe.
goo.ability.typhoon.gust.description: Channel a wind that pushes mobs in its cone away along your aim.
goo.ability.typhoon.updraft.cost_mechani: Costs %s per block of Updraft laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.typhoon.updraft.description: Held stream sprays Updraft, a breezy goo that lifts whatever stands above it a block for each layer.
goo.ability.unstable.blast.description: Explodes where the goo lands; hold on a block face and drag for a bigger blast.
goo.ability.unstable.nitro.cost_mechanic: Costs %s per block of Nitro laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.unstable.nitro.description: Held stream sprays Nitro, a volatile unstable goo.
goo.ability.weird.goop.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of slime laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.weird.goop.description: Held slime makes floors bouncy and leaves struck mobs dealing only knockback.
goo.ability.void.cancel.description: Removes the struck mob from the world, with no reward.
goo.ability.void.hole.description: Opens a hole on a floor that stands open temporarily and keeps every item thrown in; opened on a ceiling it pours them all back out.
goo.ability.void.zone.description: Hold to enter your own dimension and, inside, to widen it on every side; the doorway takes you back.
goo.ability.void.vacuum.description: Hold to drain every goo in the world in front of you a layer at a time, giving back all the goo it holds, and to draw in the items and mobs before you.
goo.ability.void.zone.cost_mechanics: %s void to enter. Inside, holding on costs void each second, rising as the room grows.
goo.ability.weird.mitosis.description: The blob becomes a small slime where it lands.
goo.ability.xeno.unveil.description: Makes you eldritch: you see things out of phase, and they see you.
goo.ability.zoo.allure.description: Drives an animal to mate, if it can.
goo.ability.yarn.herd.description: Senses every creature around you through walls with its health, and peaceful ones follow you.
goo.ability.yarn.lead.description: The peaceful creature it lands on fights your enemies with more health and speed, until you strike it.
goo.ability.yarn.stitch.cost_mechanics: Costs %s per block of Stitch laid, a fifteenth of it per layer.
goo.ability.yarn.stitch.description: Held stream sprays Stitch, a woolly goo peaceful creatures walk through and hostile ones tangle in, burning easily.
goo.ability.zoo.shape.description: Turns a slime into a random peaceful mob of its biome.
goo.ability.zoo.spawn.description: Turns a struck slime into a random hostile mob of its biome.
goo.ability.cost_mechanics.upkeep: Costs nothing to start, then %s a second until you invoke it again or run dry.
goo.ability.param.cost.cost.description: Goo in mB that one use of the ability costs.
goo.ability.param.cost_per_knife.cost.de: Goo in mB that each knife costs as it forms, returned for every knife still hovering when the hold is let go.
goo.ability.param.cost_per_block.cost_pe: Goo in mB added to the cost for each block the blink travels.
goo.ability.param.node_percent.node_perc: Percent of the full price a Blink to an Oculus costs, 100 for the full price.
goo.ability.param.upkeep.upkeep.descript: The mB the held effect drains each tick it stands.
goo.ability.param.wall_cost.wall_cost.de: The mB added to a blink's cost when it passes through a solid block.
goo.ability.param.zone.cell_cost.descrip: Void goo in mB a platform cell costs at the room's center.
goo.ability.param.zone.distance_cost.des: Void goo in mB each block a cell stands from the room's center adds to its cost.
goo.ability.param.zone.enter.description: Void goo in mB the trip into your pocket room costs.
